digest.component_or_area: ticket summary resolution and agent guidance
propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state through show_state but omits the resolved alias from its return payload, causing agents to select locally-salient four-character prefixes over durable aliases
CLI JSON, library, and MCP summary contracts institutionalize an alias-free schema shape that does not expose the resolved ticket alias to callers
agent guidance lacks an affirmative rule instructing agents to use aliases for tracker commands after discovery while reserving canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts

pinned behavioral evaluation demonstrated that adding the resolved alias to local summaries independently produces 25/25 alias-based commands, and adding the affirmative guidance rule independently produces 25/25 aliases

the fix adds the exact resolved alias as an additive field on every resolvable summary result while preserving ticket_id echo semantics, fail-closed ambiguous-prefix behavior, and canonical UUID contracts
